# TANEGASIMA

> TANEGASIMA is a Japan-based robotics solutions provider focused on humanoid robots, quadruped robots, service robots, and deployment support for enterprise, research, inspection, and guidance scenarios.

- TANEGASIMA provides robotics solution design, deployment planning, PoC support, localization support for the Japan market, and software integration around advanced robotic platforms.
